g.text: The Sorted Set IS the Leaderboard, Not a Cache in Front of One
An idempotency check gates every write; the event log is what makes the in-memory structure recoverable
The sorted-set store answers every read directly -- it is not a cache in front of a database, it IS the low-latency system of record.
The event log exists purely so a shard can be rebuilt after total replica-set loss; replication alone protects against a single node failing, not that.
